title: [テーブル設計][書いてみよう] 複合主キーで中間テーブルを作成する
statement:
学生、講座、受講登録を保存する students, courses, enrollments テーブルを作成してください。students は id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL、courses は id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL とします。

enrollments は student_id, course_id, enrolled_at を NOT NULL とし、(student_id, course_id) を複合主キーにします。それぞれ students(id), courses(id) への外部キーも設定してください。

constraints.name: 作成するテーブル
constraints.value: students, courses, enrollments の3つを作成します

constraints.name: 複合主キー
constraints.value: enrollments は PRIMARY KEY (student_id, course_id) にします

constraints.name: 外部キー
constraints.value: enrollments.student_id は students.id、enrollments.course_id は courses.id を参照します

checkSql: SELECT 'column' AS check_type, m.name AS table_name, p.name AS item_name, UPPER(p.type) AS detail, p."notnull" AS required, p.pk AS key_order FROM sqlite_master AS m JOIN pragma_table_info(m.name) AS p WHERE m.type = 'table' AND m.name IN ('students', 'courses', 'enrollments') UNION ALL SELECT 'foreign_key' AS check_type, m.name AS table_name, f."from" AS item_name, f."table" || '.' || f."to" AS detail, '' AS required, '' AS key_order FROM sqlite_master AS m JOIN pragma_foreign_key_list(m.name) AS f WHERE m.type = 'table' AND m.name = 'enrollments' ORDER BY check_type, table_name, item_name;
